questions.reasoning: 1 mark for formula, 2 marks for correct figures, 1 mark for the final percentage value.

questions.question: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of capacity utilization falling below 70% for a hotel chain.
questions.modelAnswer: Advantage: More time for deep cleaning and maintenance. Disadvantage: Higher unit fixed costs per occupied room, reducing profit margins.
questions.reasoning: 2 marks for capacity concept understanding, 2 marks for advantage explanation, 2 marks for disadvantage explanation linked to fixed overhead absorption.
